contractName: Viet Template 1.0 Framework Configuration Keys Contract
description: Authoritative machine-readable inventory of frozen public configuration keys for Spring Boot and Quarkus framework integrations.

properties.name: viet-template.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Viet Template auto-configuration.

properties.name: viet-template.prefix
properties.description: Prefix that gets prepended to view names when building a template identifier.

properties.name: viet-template.suffix
properties.description: Suffix that gets appended to view names when building a template identifier.

properties.name: viet-template.suffixes
properties.description: Ordered list of suffixes appended to view names when resolving template identifiers. Takes precedence over suffix when non-empty.

properties.name: viet-template.content-type
properties.description: Content-Type value for template views.

properties.name: viet-template.charset
properties.description: Character encoding used for template rendering and output encoding.

properties.name: viet-template.cache
properties.description: Whether to enable caching of resolved view instances.

properties.name: viet-template.check-template-location
properties.description: Whether to check that the template location exists.

properties.name: viet-template.runtime-compilation-enabled
properties.description: Whether dynamic runtime compilation of templates is permitted. If false, only precompiled AOT templates are allowed.

properties.name: viet-template.max-cache-entries
properties.description: Maximum number of entries retained in the template engine compilation cache.

properties.name: viet-template.negative-cache-ttl-millis
properties.description: Time-to-live in milliseconds for negative cache entries (non-existent template lookups).

properties.name: viet-template.hot-reload
properties.description: Whether filesystem watching and hot reload are enabled for template source changes.

properties.name: viet-template.watch-debounce-millis
properties.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds for filesystem watch events during hot reload.

properties.name: viet-template.order
properties.description: ViewResolver order in the Spring MVC resolver chain.

properties.name: viet-template.security.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Spring Security integration for Viet Template.

properties.name: quarkus.viet-template.path
properties.description: Base path within the classpath where templates are located.

properties.name: quarkus.viet-template.suffix
properties.description: Primary file suffix for templates.

properties.name: quarkus.viet-template.additional-suffixes
properties.description: Additional file suffixes for templates.

properties.name: quarkus.viet-template.runtime-compilation-enabled
properties.description: Whether runtime template compilation is allowed. Defaults to false in production, true in development mode.

properties.name: quarkus.viet-template.cache-max-entries
properties.description: Maximum number of entries in the template compilation cache.

properties.name: quarkus.viet-template.negative-cache-ttl-millis
properties.description: Negative cache time-to-live in milliseconds.

properties.name: quarkus.viet-template.undefined-reference-policy
properties.description: Policy governing evaluation behavior on undefined references (SILENT, WARN, ERROR).

properties.name: quarkus.viet-template.encoding
properties.description: Character encoding for reading templates.
